name: 물약 보관장
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a staged equipment sprite sheet for a tiny cozy witch-shop game. True transparent alpha background. Strict chunky hard-square pixel art, dark plum #432039 stepped outline, antique gold metalwork #efc77c, ivory highlights, muted violet wood and sage accents, 4 flat shade clusters. Every object fully visible, front view, same scale and base y within each cell, generous empty margins, no overlaps, no text, lettering, digits, floor, cast shadow, glow, blur or background scene. Objects should remain readable in 32x40 logical pixels per cell. EXACT 3 columns and ONE row of equal-sized cells. Subject is a compact plum wooden cupboard with two glass-pane doors and three colored bottle silhouettes inside. Left cell: simple BASIC version. Middle cell: IMPROVED version with gold door frame and simple brass latch. Right cell: PREMIUM version with gold arched crest, lavender inset gemstone, six simple bottle silhouettes behind glass. All variants retain the same core function and silhouette family, with clearly stronger gold framing at each stage. Do not use extra floating badges or place text anywhere.
